# Nested computed matching

Three unchanged Apache-2.0 originals from pinned Bend
`e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599`:
`tests/flatten/nested_computed_match_001`, `_dec` and `_zro`.
Derived normal forms, graphs and diagnostics retain that attribution.
New tests, adapters and wrappers use MPL-2.0.

All original mains are functions and require Base for standalone compilation.
Separate Base-importing adapters reach actual function-printer refusals.
The 12 inputs cover Nt depths 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 for the main and zero worker,
and both Boolean constructors for the decision worker. Named-call normalization,
complete closed values, scalar projections and executable output are compared
separately. Historical imported-printer failures are not waived by this batch.
